snippet.title: Isotope: Unstable Atom Puzzles – Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Slide atoms, bond real molecules and stay one move ahead of radioactive decay. Isotope is a sliding puzzle game with real chemistry inside: 100 handcrafted levels across ten worlds, 119 real chemicals to discover and a hidden event in every level. The first world is free.

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.strujiclabs.isotope
App Store (iPhone, iPad, Apple TV): https://apps.apple.com/app/isotope-unstable-atom-puzzles/id6822451924

#puzzlegame #chemistry #indiegame
